bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
name=deploy-gaybbs-1
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name")" = true || exit 61
docker exec "$name" sh -c "grep -q 'start=link' /app/publishMenuPanels.mjs" || exit 62
docker exec "$name" sh -c "grep -q 'post:link:cancel' /app/gaybbs.mjs" || exit 63
docker exec "$name" sh -c "grep -q 'dm:link' /app/gaybbs.mjs" || exit 64
states="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state='published') || '|' || COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state='needs_reconcile') FROM board_menu_panels WHERE panel_type='posting';")"
test "$states" = "2|1" || exit 65
echo LINK_BUNDLE_AND_2_PANELS=PASS
echo THIRD_MENU_NEEDS_RECONCILE=YES
